visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female character with black hair and white-rimmed glasses is shown in a bright kitchen setting. She is holding a white digital kitchen scale with both hands towards the camera, smiling warmly. The background features wooden shelves and kitchenware, with soft natural light coming from the side. (2) The scene transitions to a top-down view of a kitchen counter. The character is seen pouring milk from a glass measuring cup into a bowl placed on the white scale. The scale displays numbers clearly. Her hands are precisely moving. (3) The character is seen holding the scale under a running faucet in a white sink. Water flows directly over the scale's surface. She then applies a liquid cleaner to the scale, demonstrating its waterproof capability. (4) A close-up shot shows the scale's display changing from 'HELLO' to weight measurements. The character pours small amounts of a white powder into a bowl, highlighting the 0.1g precision. Later, a large container of flour is placed on the scale, reaching nearly 3kg. (5) The final sequence shows a close-up of a perfectly baked loaf of bread being handled. The character reappears, gesturing enthusiastically while holding a yellow bag of flour. The video ends with a call to action text overlay.
